text: If a red-black tree has black-height 3, the left subtree could be completely full of black nodes, in which case there would be 3 nodes. The right subtree could alternate red and black nodes. If we alternate as long as possible the result is 31 nodes in the right subtree. Therefore red-black trees can have subtree-sizes that are quite different.
